learnings: Parameter order is fixed: positional-only, `/`, standard, `*args`, keyword-only, `**kwargs`.
A keyword-only parameter after `*args` can be required (no default).
pitfalls: Illegal signatures are `SyntaxError`s at compile time – compiling them in a test proves the rules.
